title: Monthly CoroCoro Comic Magazine to Release Digital Version 1 Week After Print Version
content: The official X/Twitter account for Shogakukan 's Monthly CoroCoro Comic magazine announced on November 13 that the magazine's digital version will begin releasing about one week after the physical magazine's release (as opposed to the current simultaneous releases) beginning with the current December issue that…
author: ANN

title: Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom Webtoon Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content: Piccoma , Kakao's Japanese digital comics platform, announced on Thursday a television anime adaptation of the webtoon/web novel Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom , which has accumulated more than 100 million views across Kakao's and Tapas ' platforms.
author: ANN

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Game Launches in 2027
content: Taito announced that its game based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series will launch in 2027. Taito is developing the game for Switch.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Leviathan Film Casts Shun Oguri, Ai Hashimoto
content: The staff for the live-action film of Shiro Kuroi 's Leviathan manga announced on Thursday two more cast members. Shun Oguri (left in image below) plays Senri Senda, and Ai Hashimoto (right in image below) plays Yuriko Momose. Both characters are teachers trapped in the survival battle with their students.
author: ANN

title: Webtoon 'Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom' Gets TV Anime
content: Publishing company Kakao Piccoma announced a television anime adaptation of Ilu and Moguraeng 's Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom webtoon on Thursday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured). The anime will premiere under the Japanese title Mamahaha dakedo Musume ga Kawaisugiru .
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sesuji's About a Pilgrimage to the Defiled Sacred Grounds Novel Gets Live-Action Film in 2027
content: Flag Pictures announced on Thursday that Sesuji 's About a Pilgrimage to the Defiled Sacred Grounds ( Kegareta Seichijunrei ni Tsuite ) novel is inspiring a live-action film that will open in Japan in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Blood Addict Manga Ends
content: The December issue of Square Enix 's G Fantasy magazine announced on Wednesday that Umiharu 's Blood Addict ( Bloodict ) manga will end in the next issue on December 18. Manga UP!
author: ANN

title: K Manga Adds Godmother Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Tuesday that it has added Rin Shimokawa 's Godmother manga as a simulpub title. The platform describes the story: "Who should these children call 'Grandma' after I pass away?" Kinryu, a Chinese college student, was suddenly told to move to Japan.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s Solo Leveling Update Reveals It’s Aiming to Perfect One Role That the Anime Forgot
content: The latest update on Netflix’s Solo Leveling live-action adaptation hints at perfecting one role that the original series didn’t. Solo Leveling is a power fantasy series focused on a man who aims to become the best version of himself, acquiring wealth and power for himself and his family.
author: ComicBook
